_comment: Pages and profiles for scripts/ci/lighthouse.mjs (taken from avagolf.com; see its header). Copied from news.avagolf.com's lighthouse.config.json.
One page per template: the homepage (hero header and the brand pack), a guideline page, a content-collection page, and the video page.
`served.headStart` is the edge tag-gateway bootstrap, byte for byte as Fastly injects it at the
top of <head> on brand.avagolf.com; if the gateway changes, copy it again from view-source of the live site.
The gateway also carries the GA4 hits (/cv9l/ga/g/c, /cv9l/ag/g/c): `only` keeps the proxy to the
gateway scripts, and */g/c* blocks the hits in Chrome as well, so no run sends a real hit.
brand's own gtag.js (G-X34R7TJNMF) loads in `served` and is blocked in `code`; its hits go to /g/collect, which *collect* blocks.
Gates sit a few points under the measured medians, so a real regression fails and runner noise does not.

`only` forwards just the gateway loader (/cv9l/) and its content-hashed scripts; the diagnostics ping (/cv9l/td) and the GA4 hits (/cv9l/ga/g/c, /cv9l/ag/g/c) are answered locally and never reach production.

code.label: Our code: every third-party script blocked

served.label: As served: the edge's GTM loader injected, every beacon blocked
